steps.en: Install the pack, or just the SEO skill, into your coding agent
steps.zh: 把整包或只把 SEO 技能装进你的 coding agent

steps.en: Ask the agent to improve your site's search and AI visibility, giving the URL
steps.zh: 让 agent 提升网站在搜索和 AI 回答里的可见度，给出网址

steps.en: Runs a free audit of title, meta, H1, robots.txt, sitemap and load time
steps.zh: 免费审一遍标题、meta、H1、robots.txt、sitemap 和加载时间

steps.en: Name your target keywords and competitors; DataForSEO keys are optional
steps.zh: 说出目标关键词和竞品；DataForSEO 密钥可选

steps.en: Researches keywords, applies its GEO rewrite rules, drafts meta tags and FAQPage JSON-LD
steps.zh: 查关键词，按 GEO 规则改写，起草 meta 和 FAQPage 标记

steps.en: Returns an SEO/GEO report: status checklist plus prioritized fixes
steps.zh: 交回一份 SEO/GEO 报告：现状清单加按优先级排好的修改项

value.en: A prioritized fix list with ready-to-paste meta tags and schema, without hand-checking robots.txt, sitemap and markup yourself
value.zh: 拿到排好优先级的修改清单和可粘贴的 meta 与 schema，不用自己逐项查 robots.txt 和标记

sources: https://github.com/ReScienceLab/opc-skills README.md — Universal Installation: `npx skills add ReScienceLab/opc-skills --skill reddit` pattern; skills.json install.project for seo-geo: `npx skills add ReScienceLab/opc-skills --skill seo-geo`

https://github.com/ReScienceLab/opc-skills skills/seo-geo/SKILL.md — description trigger 'improve search visibility'; Step 1 Website Audit: `python3 scripts/seo_audit.py "https://example.com"` (title, meta, H1, robots, sitemap, load time; no API needed)

https://github.com/ReScienceLab/opc-skills skills/seo-geo/SKILL.md — Step 2 Keyword Research (WebSearch with {keyword} and {competitor.com}), Step 3 GEO Optimization (Princeton methods table, FAQPage schema), Step 4 meta tags template, 'Generate Report' template (Current Status / Recommendations)
https://github.com/ReScienceLab/opc-skills skills.json — seo-geo auth: DATAFORSEO_LOGIN / DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD, both optional
